name: Session replay
plain: A script records page changes, mouse, scroll and typing so staff can replay a visit like a video.
meaning: Shows exactly what the person saw and did, including text typed in forms unless masked. A 2017 Princeton study found replay scripts on 482 of the top 50,000 sites leaking data. In 2022 to 2025 US wiretap suits grew.

web.api: MutationObserver, mouse, scroll and input event listeners sending to vendor

access.persistence: Vendor retention often 30 days to 13 months
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can record your clicks, scrolls and typing on a page so staff can replay it
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens as you use a page with a replay script
can: Record page changes, mouse moves, clicks and scrolls
Record what you type, unless fields are masked
Let staff replay your visit like a video
cannot: Record other sites, tabs or apps
Show fields the site has masked, such as passwords and card numbers
Work if a tracker blocker stops the script
Name you unless the site links it to a login
limits.reach_label: Your whole visit on that site

story.what_it_is: A script records your mouse, clicks and typing so staff can replay your visit like a video.
story.for_you: You never see it. While you use a site, a script records page changes, mouse, scroll and keys. Staff may later watch your visit. It can capture text you type unless the site masks it.
story.for_makers: Teams watch real visits to find bugs and confusing screens. Replay shows what a person saw. It has also brought privacy suits, because replay scripts can capture personal data.

use_cases.example: A shop watches a replay of a checkout that failed, and finds a button that did not work on phones.
A browser game studio replays a stuck player session to find a bug in the menu.
An engineer watches the last 30 seconds before a crash to reproduce a bug.
A bank watches how people fill a loan form, with the number fields masked.
A support team opens a replay of a customer's session to see what went wrong.
A fraud team watches replay for a login session that looks scripted.

technical_bounds: Masks password and payment fields by default in most tools
Needs vendor script on page (blocked by many tools)
Cross-origin iframes need their own script
Consent required in EU and under California wiretap suits

abuse: Capturing typed text, emails and health data

history.change: Princeton: 482 of the top 50,000 sites used replay scripts

refs.label: No boundaries: session replay scripts (Freedom to Tinker 2017)
